observation: Glass fragments remain clustered near the window/frame and do not read as an explosive outward burst from a center impact; the projectile/brick impact energy is not apparent.
expected_behavior: After a fast, heavy brick hits the center of the pane, shards should erupt outward with varied velocities and trajectories, with the brick continuing through and trailing fragments; remaining pane should show clear cracking and partial collapse.
actual_behavior: Shatter appears localized and under-energetic, with limited shard spread and unclear impact staging (brick not clearly visible/centered).
